d: Nice to see some Angel-Loli representation. The title "Datenshi" 惰天使 for Slacker-Angel is a pun on "Datenshi" 堕天使 for Fallen-Angel. Probably explains the unique halo. XD
n: [Manga] [Tanioku no Kaeru] Datenshi Isourouchuu! | A Slacker Angel Is Crashing With Me! (Loli Babaa Senmon Anthology Chiyoko Maki no Juu Ni) [English] {Mistvern}
